results.content: The economy was Trump's second-strongest issue when he took office. Today it ranks among his weakest. The Silver Bulletin average shows his net approval on the economy at positive 6 points on January 21, 2025, briefly rising above positive 8 points in late January. By August 20, 2026, it had fallen to negative 28.3 points. Net approval on cost of living and inflation specifically started even lower, at negative 6 points, and has since fallen to negative 42.7 points. results.content: President Donald Trump's approval rating is at 44%, 2 points up from July. His job approval is highest on fighting crime in America's cities (48%) and immigration (47%), and lowest on handling inflation (37%) and tariffs and trade (38%). This month's poll also covered public opinion on the economy, midterm issues and messaging, U.S.-Canada trade, and conflicts in the Middle East. Download the key results here.
